label.text: Each pairing's work goes to its live members: web requests to a terminate name by request, sticky by a cookie, so a browser session stays on one member and moves, still signed in, when that member stops; a passthrough name, a WebSocket and a tunnel by connection, sticky by the client's address; a delegated call by its conversation. A member that fails or times out several times in a row is set aside for a time, then tried again. These are the edge element of this node's conf; a host name's own cookie is set on Domains.

default-field.tooltip: sticky-cookie: the cookie a terminate host's requests are sticky by, where the host names none. A request without it goes round robin
